basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1779. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1779 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A young man leans on a stone window ledge, blowing a large soap bubble through a straw; a small child peers over the ledge to watch it, and a glass of soapy water stands beside him.
alt.zh: 一个年轻人倚在石砌的窗台上，用一根麦秆吹出一个大肥皂泡；一个小孩从窗台后探出头来看，旁边放着一杯肥皂水。

note.en: Chardin painted this quiet subject in several versions; this is one of them. The bubble is almost transparent, a few touches of reflected light on brown paint, and it is about to leave the straw. Older pictures used bubbles to say that things pass quickly; Chardin seems more interested in how carefully the young man is breathing.
note.zh: 夏尔丹画过这个安静的题材好几个版本，这是其中之一。肥皂泡几乎透明，只是褐色颜料上几点反光，眼看就要离开麦秆。更早的画常用肥皂泡来说明万物易逝；夏尔丹似乎更在意那个年轻人呼气时有多小心。
